contract.total: Direct equipped-record matches plus direct backpack-record matches. Not backpack-only.
contract.normalMatch: Both artifact type and subtype must match; ordinary requested artifacts have subtype-1.
contract.componentQualification: No decomposition, component-table walk, recursive ownership helper or implicit part expansion. A physically present direct record matching type/subtype is counted even if some independent lock metadata is set. Whether a particular native assembly operation physically leaves part records in any locked slot is not established by the count loop alone.
contract.whatNotToSubstitute: Do not use a owns-artifact-or-containing-combination predicate such as native HasArtOnDoll; A2 is a raw direct-record count.
contract.scrollAndExtendedIdLimit: Arguments1000 and>1000 have special encoding. Rule119 rejects artifact source IDs<7; no claim here about plugin-specific artifacts beyond that original encoding.

rule119.assemblyExample: If the direct records contain only a combination artifact and no matching part record, A2 does not infer/count that part. A new direct pickup of the part is counted normally.

answer.nativeEquippedRepresentation: Combination root is the only directly stored combination artifact. Component records are removed, with type=-1 and subtype=-1. Secondary reserved slots are represented by separate reservation counts, not component artifact IDs.
answer.reservedMetadata: Byte counters at hero+1c5+slotCategory, as addressed by equip/unequip loops; these are independent of19equipped artifact type/subtype records.
assemblySequence: Unequip selected original component if an explicit slot was supplied.
Unequip remaining mask-matched components from equipped records.
Equip new combinationID/-1 root through ordinary equip helper.
Ordinary combination equip updates stats/reservation counts from component metadata without installing component IDs.
disassemblySequence: Unequip combo root and decrement associated reservation counters.
Create each componentID/-1 as an ordinary equipped record through the same equip helper.
answer.initialEquippingOfPreassembledCombo: Ordinary equip helper also establishes reservation counts directly from combo metadata. It does not synthesize physical component-ID records in secondary slots. This covers a root passed through this helper, not every possible external map loader or plugin path.
answer.effectOnHEA2: Previously established HE:A2 scans raw direct type/subtype records. Hidden/implicit combo parts are not counted while assembled; components count again once disassembled into direct records.
answer.vcmiTranslation: Ignore locked=true slots used as assembly-part placeholders, and do not recurse into parts of root artifacts in equipped inventory or backpack. Count the combination root itself if its own type is queried. Independently locked real direct artifacts must still count: original HE:A2 checks no lock flag.

regions.name: Assembly removes remaining direct component records
regions.observation: Reverse scan over19equipped slots; for each artifact still required in component mask, clears its bit and calls4e2e40(slot). Repeats until bitset empty.

regions.name: Assembly installs only combination root

regions.name: Unequip helper clears physical type and subtype

regions.name: Equip helper writes one physical record
regions.observation: Copies passed record type and subtype only into the selected main equipped slot.

regions.name: Combination equip reserves categories separately
regions.observation: Reads root ArtInfo+14 combination index, iterates component bitset to update stats and increments reservation count byte hero+1c5+componentSlotCategory for required secondary categories. No equipped component-type record is written in this loop.

regions.name: Combination unequip clears category reservations

regions.name: Disassembly removes combo and reinstalls component records
regions.observation: Reads combo index from equipped root, unequips it via4e2e40. Iterates component bitset and creates each partID/-1 record through4e2c70(record,-1).

answer.conditions: Ordinary object type5 visit reaches native handler, no before-trigger cancellation, hero remains owned, no guardians blocking rule119. Primary native handler returns normally on full backpack.
answer.reason: WoG wrapper emits stage1 object after-trigger after ordinary vanilla visit returns, independently of pickup success/result.
answer.primaryCapacityGuard: Before guards and auto-equipping,49f450 calls4d9330(hero,true), reads signed OANum byte+3d4, and proceeds only if signed count<64. Count64refuses even with an otherwise free compatible equipped slot.
answer.normalPrimaryPlacement: When bagcount<64, native pickup eventually calls4e32e0 which first attempts automatic equipped placement then fallback backpack. Thus ordinary pickup is not always backpack-only.
answer.extraCopyScriptPlacement: Rule119 one-argument positive HE:A is a different receiver path: it writes only a free backpack record, no automatic equipped placement.
answer.rule119EffectWithFull64BagAndFreeHand: Native primary pickup fails; post-trigger executes; A2 may report0or1existing direct copies; attempted HE:A extra also fails because backpack has no free record; final source condition clears N15. Map object remains; no new artifact is given.
answer.rule119EffectWithFull64BagAndOccupiedHan: Same primary failure, after-trigger and N15 clearing, assuming the other source119 gates pass.
answer.guardedException: Rule119 checks remaining guardians before attempted copy/final marker clear; a still-guarded artifact takes its explicit early exit, not this unguarded failure continuation.
answer.non15Marker: Source final reset only when prior N==15. Other nonzero numbers retain their cell value.
answer.currentAdapterRisk: A post-effect invoked only after successful putArtifact misses native source marker clearing on initial capacity failure. FIRST_AVAILABLE may also succeed at auto-equip when native initial bag64guard would refuse.
